ideas.pitch: A multilingual AI voice assistant tailored for rural health workers to instantly triage symptoms and check vaccine schedules offline-first.
ideas.problem_statement: Algonex 1.0 General Track: Real-world problem solving in healthcare and accessibility for semi-urban and rural communities.
ideas.title: Gramin Swasthya AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles social impact with a working voice demo, mirroring the success of SAGACITY at First Prize Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered interview preparation app that parses student resumes to conduct role-specific mock video interviews with real-time feedback.
ideas.problem_statement: Algonex 1.0 General Track: Empowering students and job seekers with modern career tools.
ideas.title: ResumeReady MockCoach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a massive student pain point at Maya Devi University directly, making the live demo instantly relatable to judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated garbage classification prototype using computer vision and a microcontroller to sort recyclable waste instantly.
ideas.problem_statement: Algonex 1.0 General Track: IoT and sustainability solutions for smart campuses.
ideas.title: EcoSort IoT Bin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hardware with a live visual demo, replicating the high-impact hardware-software synergy seen in winning IoT and robotics hacks.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local civic commerce app connecting neighborhood micro-vendors with real-time digital storefronts and foot-traffic analytics.
ideas.problem_statement: Algonex 1.0 General Track: Mobile applications and tech solutions for local economic development.
ideas.title: LocalLend Micro-Commerce
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features a live merchant dashboard and clear economic benefit, similar to the winning formula of Chatswood AI Real-World Impact Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An IoT-based power grid monitoring system for university dorms to track energy consumption anomalies and automate conservation alerts.
ideas.problem_statement: Algonex 1.0 General Track: IoT and emerging technologies for smart campus infrastructure.
ideas.title: CampusPulse IoT Energy Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate institutional problem for the host university (Maya Devi University) with concrete, measurable cost-saving metrics.
